 Preliminary 3.0 magnitude earthquake strikes near Hollister 
 By NBC Bay Area staff • 
 Published October 22, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 22, 2026 at 3:10 pm 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Are you prepared for the next big one? 
 A preliminary 3.0 magnitude earthquake struck near Hollister, according to the United States Geological Survey .
 The quake hit at 2:58 p.m. and was centered 14.6 miles south-southeast of Hollister, the USGS said.
